svg.title: My coordination: what is not done, and who to remind
svg.desc: An admin makes a teacher a coordinator. On My coordination, a section with attendance not taken leads to its attendance sheet, a pending mark sheet leads to the mark sheet, and Notify teachers sends one reminder to the chosen teachers.
